name: Wendigo
lore: It is believed that a traveler can turn into a Wendigo when forced to consume human flesh, either for survival or during some twisted ritual

name: Karakondjul
description: A dark, goblin-like nocturnal demon with a shaggy coat, buring red eyes, and sharp goat-like horns.
lore: Active during the dark winter days from Christmas to Epiphany, this monster tricks late-night travelers onto its back and rides them to exhaustion before throwing them off cliffs.

name: Leshy
description: A tall woodland guardian made of bark and roots, with green hair and eyes that glow like burning forest embers.
lore: As the master of the deep forest, the Leshy can shrink to the size of a blade of grass or swell to the height of the tallest oak. It leads hunters astray by imitating human voices.

name: Strigoi
description: A reanimated corpse with gaunt features, elongated claws, and blood-soaked teeth rising from desecrated graves.
lore: The troubled soul of a deceased person returning from the dead to absorb the vitality of their living relatives. It is considered a direct precursor to modern vampire legends.

name: Samodiva
description: An ethereal nymph of extreme beauty, wearing floating white gowns and glowing with mesmerizing woodland magic.
lore: Slavic forest spirits that dance in moonlit clearings. Any mortal who witnesses their dance is lured into a trance and forced to dance until dying of total exhaustion.

name: Dybbuk
description: A restless, invisible spirit that manifests as a harsh double-voice, violent spasms, and levitation within a human host.
lore: A malicious spirit of a deceased person who, instead of moving on, wanders the earth to possess the bodies of living humans to complete unresolved evil tasks.

name: Hellhound
description: A massive, black-furred hound with eyes that burn like hot coals, leaving scorching footprints wherever it runs.
lore: Fearsome beasts tasked in medieval Christian demonology with hunting down condemned souls or guarding the gates to the underworld.

name: Draugr
description: An undead corpse swollen to immense weight, with decaying blue-black flesh and the stench of graves and rotting seaweed.
lore: Reanimated dead warriors who guard their burial mounds with unnatural strength. They can alter their size, step through earth, and drive travelers mad.

name: Nuckelavee
description: A skinless, grotesque terror fusing a human torso directly to the back of a horse, with black blood flowing visible in yellow veins.
lore: A abhorrent sea pestilence that ventures onto land during cold nights, breath withering crops and spreading plague among livestock.

name: Kallikantzaros
description: A small, scrawny, ape-like creature with dark fur, long ears, red eyes, and a crooked tail.
lore: Subterranean imps that surface only during the Twelve Days of Christmas. They cause chaos in villages, spoiling food, tangling threads, and scaring late-night wanderers.

name: Manananggal
description: An elder woman whose upper torso detaches at the waist, sprouting giant bat-like wings and a long tubular tongue.
lore: A predatory nocturnal creature that hunts from the air while its lower half remains hidden in the brush. Exposing its lower body to salt or sunlight destroys it.

name: Cailleach
description: An ancient, blue-faced hag adorned with a dark cloak, carrying a heavy wooden staff that freezes the ground where it strikes.
lore: A winter crone who brings the bitter cold and frost. She reshapes mountains with her hammer and turns to stone when the warm seasonal sun appears.
